name: Code Analysis Agent
description: An agent that reads source code for analysis, runs linters via shell execution, generates written reports, and manages git branches for isolated work.

code-reading.description: Reads source files using file-read to analyze code structure, patterns, and potential issues

tests.description: Agent uses file-read to read the specified source file before analysis
tests.prompt: Analyze the code quality of src/utils/parser.ts

tests.description: Agent identifies concrete issues or observations after reading code
tests.prompt: Read src/index.ts and tell me what you find

tests.description: Agent does not fabricate analysis without reading the file first

linter-execution.description: Runs linting tools via shell-execute to get automated code quality feedback

tests.description: Agent invokes shell-execute to run a linter
tests.prompt: Run the linter on the src/ directory and report the results

tests.description: Agent uses a recognized linting tool in its shell command
tests.prompt: Lint check the TypeScript files in this project

tests.description: Agent provides interpretation of linting results, not just raw output
tests.prompt: Run eslint on src/ and explain what the results mean

tests.description: Agent actually runs the linter rather than guessing results
tests.prompt: Check this project for linting errors

report-generation.description: Generates structured analysis reports and writes them to files using file-write

tests.description: Agent uses file-write to create a report file
tests.prompt: Analyze src/ and write a code quality report to reports/analysis.md

tests.description: Agent generates a report with recognizable structure and sections
tests.prompt: Create a comprehensive code review report for the project and save it to report.md

tests.description: Agent includes findings or recommendations in the report content
tests.prompt: Generate a lint report summarizing all issues found and save to lint-report.md

git-branch-management.description: Creates git branches for isolated work using shell-execute with git commands

tests.description: Agent uses shell-execute with a git command to create a branch
tests.prompt: Create a new git branch called fix/lint-errors for the cleanup work

tests.description: Agent includes proper git branch syntax in its command
tests.prompt: Set up a branch named refactor/code-quality for the improvements

tests.description: Agent communicates what branch operation it performed
tests.prompt: Create a branch called feat/analysis-report and confirm it was created

tests.description: Agent does not refuse or hallucinate when asked to create a branch
tests.prompt: We need a new branch for fixing the linting issues. Create one with an appropriate name.
